title: Dark Spots & Pigmentation
description: Sun spots, uneven tone, or dark post-acne marks.

title: Redness & Rosacea
description: Flushed patches, visible capillaries, or blotchiness.

title: Fine Lines & Wrinkles
description: Smile lines, crow's feet, or loss of firmness.

title: Dark Marks
description: Small, localized dark marks left behind after a blemish heals.

title: Dryness
description: Rough texture, tightness, or visible flaking across the face.

title: Excess Oil
description: Persistent shine and greasiness, especially in the T-zone.

title: Sensitivity
description: Stinging, burning, or irritation when trying new products.

title: Fine Lines
description: Early, shallow lines around the eyes and mouth.

title: Uneven Skin Tone
description: Patchy or blotchy colouring across the face, no single dominant cause.
